Good Afternoon,
We have received approval for 2 options:
A. We will settle the balance with a 1 time payment of $3,000.00 which can be made via credit card if necessary.
B. B. We can stop the payment for 2 weeks, run half payments for 2 weeks and then resume the full payment until the full remaining balance is repaid.
Let me know which you would like to move forward with.
Thank you,
Modification Department
National Funding, Inc., the parent and servicing company of
Quick Bridge Funding, LLC 9820 Towne Centre Drive San Diego, CA 92121
